name: app-blue-flight-tracker-search-screen-held-with-ghost-title
title: Blue Flight Tracker Search in Hand
whatItIs: A pale blue gradient cover with giant faint 'FlightTrac' lettering and a hand holding a white phone showing a 'Where is My Flight' search form with route toggle, fields and a bright blue search button.
whatItMeans: A pure blue-and-white UI feels clear and trustworthy, and the ghost title adds depth.
techniques: Ghost name cropped behind the phone
Single bright blue for the primary button
White cards on pale blue background
Segmented tab for route or flight code

vocabulary.definition: Oversized faint lettering behind a subject.
A two-option toggle at the top of a form.
The main coloured action on a screen.
